candidates.description: This vector represents prefixes and roots of academic disciplines and specialized fields of study.
This feature vector represents the concept of usage, application, and utility across various grammatical forms and related terms in Romance languages.
This vector represents words and subwords starting with or containing the Latin root "inter-" or "int-".
This feature vector represents abstract nouns related to structured operational activities, procedures, and documentation.
This feature vector represents the concept of artificial intelligence, automation, and related technological or synthetic processes.
This vector represents tokens containing the letter sequence "im" across various words and prefixes.
The tokens represent morphemes, stems, and prefixes associated with deep thinking, responsibility, and autonomy across multiple languages.
This vector activates strongly in response to scientific terminology, particularly concepts related to physics, computing, and advanced technology.
This vector activates for word fragments and roots related to capability, adaptation, and transformation across multiple languages.
This vector is related to common Spanish adjectival suffixes and word endings.
